yt.title: One grain doubled 64 times is 18.4 quintillion grains #Shorts
yt.description:
Rice on a chessboard: 1 grain on the first square, doubled on each of 64 squares. Total 2^64 - 1 = {c_t}.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Put one grain of rice on the first chess square, and double it on every square after.

scenes.label: grains in total on 64 squares
scenes.narration: Sixty four squares, doubling each time. The total is about {c_say} grains.
Our intuition handles adding well, but doubling grows faster than we expect.
